entities.summary: Amadou Aboubakar Zaki is a Nigerien professional basketball player, who plays for Union Rennes Basket 35. Standing at 7 ft 0 in, Zaki usually plays as power forward or center. Zaki has played in France and in Denmark as a professional player.
